skill_outcomes.outcome_description: Understand and apply fundamental concepts of event management, including planning and execution of meetings, incentives, conferences, and exhibitions (MICE).
Analyze market trends and factors influencing the MICE industry in Vietnam and globally.
Evaluate economic and financial indicators for event services.
Coordinate and manage resources effectively to execute event tasks.
Develop and implement marketing strategies for MICE services.
Utilize information technology in MICE management processes.
Propose and present innovative event ideas and manage teams effectively.
Negotiate and secure sponsorships for events.
Understand legal and environmental considerations in MICE management.
Manage MICE events with an international perspective.
